name: Homans lot, Gilman Square (City-owned)
label: Homans lot

name: Union Square block D3.2 (US2)
label: Union Sq D3
note: Union Square's master plan (Planning Board, Dec 14, 2017) allows housing on blocks D2, D3, D4, D5 and D7, at most 998 homes in all; D2 is built (450). D3.2: 325 to 381 homes in the plan's estimate (Table 9 of the application). No building approved yet. Drawn as the whole block D3 (50 and 56 Webster Ave, 520 Columbia St: the City's 2017 land agreement with US2, Schedule 1); the homes go on lot D3.2, part of it.
